title: Verification verdict indicator
responsibility: Shows whether supplied evidence passed and exposes its explanation in an accessible tooltip.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.passed
inputs.description: Required verdict. Only the literal value true is treated as proven.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.label
inputs.description: Optional displayed verdict text. When omitted or null, uses Full coverage passed or Verification failed according to passed; an empty string is retained.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.reasons
inputs.description: Optional failure explanations, defaulting to an empty list. Suppressed for a proven verdict.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.framed
inputs.description: Optional outlined presentation, defaulting to false.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.bare
inputs.description: Accepted compatibility prop that is not read and has no effect.

outputs.name: HarnessVerdict
outputs.description: Verdict icon and tooltip. Hover or keyboard focus reveals the explanation; clicking pins it, while Escape, blur or an outside pointer action closes it. The tooltip stays within the viewport and supports keyboard scrolling when its content overflows.
